summary.text: Father of Troezenus (`troezenus-ciconian`) and grandfather of the Ciconian captain Euphemus (`euphemus-ciconian`) — attested by Homer in the Catalogue of Ships when the allied tribes muster beside Troy.

story.text: Homer's muster-roll names Euphemus captain of the Ciconian spearmen, the son of Ceas' son Troezenus, nurtured of Zeus — but the poet names Ceas only through his grandson's line.
